label: Cashback
description: Compare cards that return eligible spending as direct cashback, including caps, exclusions and annual fees.

label: Rewards
description: Compare reward-point cards by earn rate, redemption currency, fees and important exclusions.

label: Lifetime free
description: Explore cards with no joining or annual fee and compare the rewards still available without a recurring charge.

label: Low annual fee
description: Compare accessible cards charging no more than ₹500 annually before taxes and fee waivers.

label: Premium
description: Compare premium cards with higher fees, travel privileges, milestone benefits and enhanced rewards.

label: Super premium
description: Compare top-tier cards charging ₹10,000 or more annually and assess whether their premium benefits justify the fee.

label: Travel
description: Compare cards offering travel rewards, airline or hotel benefits, lounge access and lower foreign-currency costs.

label: Domestic lounge
description: Compare cards with domestic airport lounge access, including visit limits and spending conditions.

label: International lounge
description: Compare cards providing international airport lounge access and review network or programme conditions.

label: Low forex markup
description: Compare cards designed to reduce foreign-currency transaction costs for international purchases and travel.

label: Airline and air miles
description: Compare airline-focused and air-mile cards by accelerated earn rates, transfer partners and travel conditions.

label: Hotels
description: Compare cards offering hotel rewards, memberships, room benefits and accelerated hotel booking value.

label: Fuel
description: Compare fuel cards by accelerated rewards, surcharge waivers, eligible outlets and monthly caps.

label: Online shopping
description: Compare cards rewarding online purchases across marketplaces, brand partners and general e-commerce spending.

label: Dining and food delivery
description: Compare cards rewarding restaurants, dining memberships and food-delivery purchases.

label: Groceries
description: Compare cards offering accelerated rewards or cashback on supermarket and grocery purchases.

label: Utility bills
description: Compare cards that reward eligible electricity, water, gas, telecom and other recurring utility payments.

label: Movies and entertainment
description: Compare cards providing movie offers, entertainment rewards and ticket-booking benefits.

label: Health and wellness
description: Compare cards offering pharmacy, healthcare, fitness or wellness-related rewards and privileges.

label: Golf
description: Compare cards offering complimentary golf rounds, lessons or related premium privileges.

label: RuPay and UPI
description: Compare RuPay credit cards that may be linked to supported UPI apps, alongside their fees and rewards.

label: Secured and FD-backed
description: Compare cards issued against a fixed deposit for customers building or rebuilding their credit profile.

label: First credit card
description: Compare accessible starter cards with simpler fees and rewards for customers beginning their credit journey.

label: Students
description: Explore cards and secured options relevant to students or customers without an established credit history.

label: Co-branded cards
description: Compare cards created with airlines, retailers, fintechs and lifestyle brands, including partner-specific limitations.

label: Fintech cards
description: Compare app-led and fintech-partnered cards while clearly identifying the regulated issuing bank.

label: Railway travel
description: Compare cards offering railway booking rewards, IRCTC benefits or railway lounge access.

label: Insurance payments
description: Compare cards whose published terms address insurance spending, rewards or exclusions.

label: Education payments
description: Compare cards whose terms specifically address school, college or education-payment rewards and exclusions.

label: Rent payments
description: Compare cards whose published terms disclose how rent transactions are treated for rewards or exclusions.

label: Concierge services
description: Compare premium cards providing concierge assistance for travel, dining and lifestyle requests.

label: Roadside assistance
description: Compare cards offering vehicle breakdown, towing or emergency roadside-assistance benefits.
